meta.title: Graph Incdec 1 V1
meta.prompt: The graph of a function \(f(x)\) is given below. Sort the intervals on the left according to whether \(f(x)\) is increasing or decreasing on that interval. If some intervals are unused, be sure you can explain why. Graph of a polynomial function in the first quadrant. \begin{tikzpicture} \begin{axis}[ xmin=-8.5, xmax=6.5, ymin=-10.9, ymax=6.5, grid=both, xtick={-7,-5,-3,-1,1,3,5}, minor xtick={-8,-6,-4,-2,2,4,6}, ytick={-10,-6,-2,2,6}, minor ytick={-8,-4,4} ] \addplot+[domain=-8:6,samples=100] {0.002*(x+2)*(x-3)*(x+4)*(x-0.5)*(x-5)*(x+7)}; \end{axis} \end{tikzpicture}
